description_en: Calls the UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute operation to modify the attributes of an endpoint connection
description_zh: 调用UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute接口，修改终端节点连接的属性
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink update-vpc-endpoint-connection-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --endpoint-id ep-hp33b2e43fays7s80000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateVpcEndpointConnectionAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint connection bandwidth that you want to modify.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的终端节点连接带宽的地域ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:
true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改连接带宽。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the endpoint connection. Unit: Mbit/s.

The valid values vary based on the type of service resource:
NLB: 100 to 50000.
ALB: 100 to 25000.
CLB: 100 to 10240. Default value: 3072.
GWLB: 100 to 25000
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点的连接带宽。单位：Mbps。

对于不同的服务资源资源类型，取值范围分别如下：
NLB：100~50000。
ALB：100~25000。
CLB：100~10240。默认值 3072。
GWLB：100～25000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Scalability: auto scaling. In this mode, the bandwidth configured for the endpoint connection does not take effect.

BandwidthLimit: supports setting a bandwidth upper limit for the endpoint connection. The bandwidth upper limit is the value of Bandwidth.
 
When the service resource is NLB, TrafficControlMode is set to Scalability by default. You can set it to BandwidthLimit and modify the Bandwidth value to provide a bandwidth upper limit.
When the service resource is CLB, TrafficControlMode can only be set to BandwidthLimit, which indicates that the service consumer provides a default rate limit for each endpoint.
When the service resource is GWLB, TrafficControlMode can only be set to Scalability
parameters.help_zh:
Scalability：自动弹性，在该模式下，针对终端连接设置的连接带宽无效。

BandwidthLimit：支持对终端连接设置带宽上限，带宽上限为Bandwidth值。
 
当服务资源为NLB时，TrafficControlMode默认设置为Scalability，可以设置为BandwidthLimit并修改Bandwidth值来提供带宽上限。
当服务资源为CLB时，TrafficControlMode仅支持设置BandwidthLimit，表示服务使用方为每个终端节点提供默认限速。
当服务资源为GWLB时，TrafficControlMode仅支持设置Scalability
parameters.name: traffic_control_mode
